summary: Frontend-only visual verification of the 'black box around product image' bug fix on Product Detail pages and Shop page. Passed age gate (data-testid='age-gate-yes'), navigated to /product/rasta-mango-5, /product/cannazo-uplift-cola, /product/moon-impact-stellardust and /shop. Confirmed via screenshots that the product images now float as true transparent cutouts over the celestial background (drifting stars + faint rotating COSMOS seal watermark + soft red radial glow). There is NO visible black rectangular box/square around any pack on any of the 3 PDPs or on the shop cards. The COSMOS seal watermark PNG served at /brand-assets/logos/cosmos-seal.png is confirmed colorType=6 (RGBA) with fully transparent corners (alpha=0). Product name, price, THC/CBD/Effect/Flavor spec grid, quantity stepper, Add to Bag and Buy Now buttons render with no layout breakage on all 3 PDPs. Shop page renders 14 product cards on dark celestial tiles with BALANCE / FOCUS / SLEEP effect badges visible.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetail.js and ProductCard.js correctly removed mix-blend-screen and radial mask workarounds; images are now clean object-contain PNGs with drop-shadow — this is the right approach now that the source PNGs are true alpha cutouts.
The COSMOS seal watermark is served at 844KB (1024x1024 RGBA). Consider optimizing (WebP or reduced PNG palette) since it is used as a background on every PDP.

Sampled product img in JS resolved to the seal watermark (first inside the celestial container). Not a bug — just note for future automated pixel-diff tests: scope the selector to a container that excludes the watermark, e.g. add data-testid="product-hero-image" on the actual product . Recommend adding this testid to make automated visual regression easier.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for the black-box-around-product-image on Product Detail pages is visually verified across rasta-mango-5, cannazo-uplift-cola, moon-impact-stellardust and the /shop grid. If further automated pixel-level regression is needed, request main agent add data-testid='product-hero-image' on the actual product in ProductDetail.js — currently the first inside product-detail-page is the cosmos-seal watermark, which trips up naive selectors.
rca of the issue: Original bug: product images rendered inside an opaque black square because the source PNGs had a solid black background and the previous fix relied on mix-blend-screen + radial CSS masks, which failed on browsers/DPI combos. Mitigation applied by main agent: (1) replaced product image assets with true alpha-transparent PNGs (background alpha-keyed out) served at /brand-assets/cutout/<slug>.png, (2) removed mix-blend-mode and mask-image CSS from both ProductDetail.js and ProductCard.js so the transparent PNG composites directly over the celestial background. Verified visually — no black rectangle remains.
